title: The programme journeys read as their people said them, the parts drawn only where the words support them, and a fresh sealed set judged once
request: Phase 8: read the spent sealed programme people as dev material, fix what they showed, make the replica large enough to prove a composition, and judge the rules and the roles once on a fresh sealed set written by an independent author.
plan: Read the ten spent sealed people's misses one by one as dev material.
Fix the label words, the fraud deeds and the parts each sentence supports.
Enlarge the replica so a composition above its best leaf can be shown with its interval.
Have a separate agent write ten fresh people, pin them by hash with gate v2 fixed before any run, and run each arm once.

decisions.decision: Draw only the parts the person's words support, not four parts for every fraud sentence.
decisions.why: The independent people and the owner's own morning asked for one or two parts; the old design, pinned by tests, drew linked accounts and a review list whatever was said.

decisions.decision: A review list is its own part only where the team's checks are limited.
decisions.why: A ranking part with no stated limit on review is a part beyond what the expert expects.

decisions.decision: The replica is two and a half times larger (200,000 orders, 750 bikers, 35 rings).
decisions.why: About forty confirmed cases in the holdout could not show a composition 0.17 above its best leaf with its interval.

decisions.decision: A fresh sealed set by a separate agent that read no file of the repository, gate v2 fixed and hash-pinned before the run; run once per arm, an armless record blocking every arm.
decisions.why: The first sealed set was spent by reading it; a fix measured on it cannot be judged by it.

change: dclab_core.card (label words; the unusual rows inferred when nothing is labelled), conversation._file_named, problem_map (fraud deeds, ride-level, rings, limited review; parts selected from what was said), the decomposer prompt, programme journeys (SIZE, accounts uploaded first, a single problem routed again on its project's tables, sealed_v2 with SEALED_HASHES, GATE_V2, a per-arm run-once guard), the regression case RG-01's steps; dclab-core 0.96.0.

findings.defect: Answers saying no case was ever confirmed were read as a file of cases.
findings.scenario: A spent sealed person: 'nobody ever confirmed anything', 'there is no list'.
findings.cause: The label words matched 'confirmed' and 'list' without their negation near the cases.
findings.fix: _labels_in denies only near the cases' words.

findings.defect: Fraud said by its deeds never set the fraud programme off.
findings.scenario: 'closing jobs with no movement', 'accounts set up together to feed fares'.
findings.cause: FRAUD matched the word fraud and a few synonyms only.

findings.defect: Every fraud sentence got the linked accounts and a review list whatever it said.
findings.scenario: A person asking only about rings got four parts, one beyond the expert's at least twice.
findings.cause: _fraud returned a fixed set of parts.
findings.fix: _fraud selects the parts the words support; linked accounts alone and the rides alone are one problem each.

findings.defect: A card with nothing labelled and no kind of answer stopped the walk.
findings.scenario: A person who says nothing is labelled and asks for the odd ones.
findings.cause: The family was never inferred without labels.
findings.fix: The anomaly or segmentation family is inferred when the labels are none.

findings.defect: The journey harness never brought the accounts to a single problem's draft.
findings.scenario: A single-problem person whose rings need the accounts table.
findings.cause: The accounts were uploaded only for a programme.
findings.fix: The accounts are uploaded first, and a single problem is routed again on plan_card after attaching them.

findings.defect: The run-once guard read an armless record as no arm's.
findings.scenario: An old record without an arm field: every arm could run the sealed set again.
findings.cause: The guard compared arms with a missing value.
findings.fix: An armless record blocks every arm; tests patch measure to fail if it is called.

findings.defect: On the fresh sealed set five of ten people stop at a card not ready, in both arms.
findings.scenario: Sealed v2, independent author: the conversation asks what to give each row, or which column holds the outcome, and the person's words never answer it in the form the card reads.
findings.cause: The understanding conversation's reading of the answer kind and of the known cases generalised poorly from the spent set to new wording; the fixes in F1 to F4 were made on one author's people.
findings.fix: Not fixed here: the sealed set is spent; the conversation's reading goes to the next package with a new independent dev set, never tuned on sealed v2.

measurements.name: programme journeys, rules, spent sealed set read as dev
measurements.result: 9 of 10 (from 2 of 10 before the fixes); dev 6 of 6
limits: Tuned on these people; not a measurement of generalisation.

measurements.name: programme journeys sealed v2, rules (JPR-010)
measurements.gate: journeys_programme_gate_v2: at least 85% right, Wilson lower end at least 0.55, no move refused, no holdout read twice
measurements.result: 3 of 10 (95% interval 0.108 to 0.603); 0 moves refused; 0 holdouts read twice
limits: Ten people by one independent author.
Most misses stop at a card not ready.

measurements.name: programme journeys sealed v2, roles (JPR-011, live)
measurements.gate: the roles right on at least as many journeys as the rules and on at least as many of each part, every request answered, within the cap
measurements.result: 5 of 10 (0.237 to 0.763), EUR 0.2361; the suite gate failed
measurements.against_gate: better than the rules but below the suite's bar: the roles stay off
limits: The same five card stops as the rules: the roles never see those people.

outcome: The rules read the people they were fixed on (9 of 10) but only 3 of 10 fresh people; the roles reach 5 of 10. Both stay below the bar, the roles stay off, and the conversation's reading of new wording is the next thing to fix on a new dev set.
lessons: A fix measured on the set it was made from says nothing about new people: the spent set went from 2 to 9 and the fresh one stayed at 3.
Most misses were upstream of the parts being fixed: read the stage where a journey stops before fixing the stage after it.
Seal a fresh set before running it, and let an armless record block every arm.
risks: Sealed v2 is spent; the next sealed set needs another independent author.
The conversation's card questions are worded for the rules' reading, not the person's.
